gitCommit.subject: FX1: make the WAL checkpoint test independent of the -wal file's lifetime
gitCommit.body:
FX1: make the WAL checkpoint test independent of the -wal file's lifetime

- RetentionTests.TheLog_IsCheckpointedOnTheFirstRun_AndThenOnceAWeek holds an
  idle, unpooled connection open for the whole test (StoreRig.HoldLogOpen), so
  SQLite cannot remove the -wal file when a parallel rig clears the pools; it
  has no read transaction, so it does not hold up wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE).
- The log is measured with StoreRig.LogBytes (one stat; no file counts as an
  empty log) instead of a FileInfo that throws when the file is gone. The four
  assertions are unchanged: in the log, empty after the first run, left alone a
  day later, empty again a week after the last checkpoint.
- DbWriterTests.Shutdown_...: same single-stat helper instead of
  File.Exists followed by FileInfo.Length (the file could vanish in between).
- No production code changed.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
Claude-Session: https://claude.ai/code/session_01KBQausaArk3u4LVWi4qxwu
